findings.body: Both merge-archive scenarios manually populate only the `.log` file. Neither exercises a conversation present only in the current `.json` record, so removing that source from `src/forge/merge.py:129` would leave all these tests passing while violating item 5. This is a real recording state: `src/forge/codex.py:311` records the conversation before the turn is appended at line 324. Add coverage through Forge's commands, with the Codex service stubbed at its edge, proving that such a recorded conversation is also archived.
findings.title: Not done: merge archives conversations recorded outside the turn log

findings.body: If the local branch advances during merging and archiving subsequently fails, the instructed `forge merge` retry always stops at this local-head check. It cannot reach the MERGED path to archive outstanding conversations and preserve the advanced branch. The suggested `forge close` cannot repair this: `src/forge/close.py:57–60` returns through `_merged`, which only prints guidance at lines 247–258. Apply the local-head gate to open pull requests; permit cleanup retries after verifying that the merged PR has the recorded head.
findings.title: Allow cleanup retries after the local branch advances
